summary: From RPM AAP 2.4 on RHEL 8, first back up and restore onto a fresh RPM 2.4 install on RHEL 9, then upgrade to 2.6; to reach containerized 2.6 on RHEL 9 or 10 or OpenShift 2.6, then migrate the RPM 2.6 deployment (and for RHEL 10, back up and restore the container 2.6 onto RHEL 10).
questions: How do I upgrade AAP 2.4 on RHEL 8 to 2.6?
Can I upgrade AAP 2.4 on RHEL 8 directly to 2.6?
How do I move AAP 2.4 on RHEL 8 to OpenShift 2.6?

answer_card.title: Upgrade RPM AAP 2.4 on RHEL 8
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Back up 2.4 on RHEL 8 and restore it to a **fresh RPM 2.4 install on RHEL 9**.
2. Upgrade RPM 2.4 to **2.6**.
3. Optional: migrate RPM 2.6 to containerized 2.6 (RHEL 9) or to OpenShift 2.6.
4. For containerized on RHEL 10: back up container 2.6 on RHEL 9 and restore to a fresh container 2.6 install on RHEL 10.
